description: This file contains utility search algorithms, including binary search and ring range binary search, used within the Orleans runtime project.

classes.name: SearchAlgorithms
classes.description: A static class providing search algorithms such as binary search and ring range binary search.

methods.name: BinarySearch
methods.description: Performs a generic binary search on a range, using a comparer function.

methods.name: RingRangeBinarySearch
methods.description: Performs a binary search on a collection of ranges that may wrap around, suitable for consistent hash rings.
